title: Lanes inside the harness sandbox
body:
Outcome: `npm run fast` passes inside the sandbox, and one real task is delivered by a sandboxed lane holding only the token of A5, with `strictAllowlist` on.
Why: the sandbox already closes credential files, the `gh` token, hooks and git config with no configuration (`04` (f)); what fails is `git add -A` on placeholder entries (`scripts/fast-check.ts:133-134`, `04` (f2)), and an environment variable with a token name passes through.
Proof: the checks of `spike-f.md` re-run green for ordinary work; the task's PR merges; the environment inside the lane holds no credential but the limited one.
Scope: `scripts/fast-check.ts`, `.gitignore`, a settings fragment for lanes.
Order: lane for the fix; operator for the default; the delivery run after A5.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice C1.
